name: Guat'a
description: Guat'a was a barren planet located in the Outer Rim Territories near the Torch Nebula, and a haven for many criminal types. The Spice Runners of Kijimi undertook a heist on Guat'a, stealing from the warlord Smaatku.
lead_paragraphs: Guat'a was a barren planet located in the Outer Rim Territories near the Torch Nebula, and a haven for many criminal types. The Spice Runners of Kijimi undertook a heist on Guat'a, stealing from the warlord Smaatku.
